---
title: "About This Website"
---

This is the website of the American Statistical Association (ASA) Cell and Gene
Therapy Scientific Working Group. See the [home page](index.html) for an
introduction to the group and contact details for the co-chairs.

## How the site is built

- The site is a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) website. `_quarto.yml` holds the
  site configuration: the navigation bar, the theme, and the list of pages to
  render.
- Each page is a `.qmd` file in the repository root.
- Run `quarto render` (or click *Render* in RStudio) to build the site. Output
  is written to `docs/`, which is what GitHub Pages serves, so the rebuilt
  `docs/` has to be committed for changes to appear online.

## Where the content comes from

Several pages are generated from data files in `data/` rather than from text in
the `.qmd` file, so updating them does not require editing any code:

| Page | Data file |
|------|-----------|
| [Sub-teams](subteams.html) | `data/members.csv`, `data/objectives.xlsx` |
| [Presentations](presentations.html) | `data/presentations.csv` |

New presentations can be submitted through an issue form in the repository,
which opens a pull request automatically; see the
[README](https://github.com/ASA-CellGeneTx-WG/ASA-CellGeneTx-WG.github.io#adding-a-presentation).

Rendering these pages requires R together with the `readxl`, `dplyr`, `knitr`,
`glue`, `pander` and `reporttools` packages. Helper functions used by the
sub-teams page live in `tools/`. The other pages need no R at all.

The [publications](publications.html) and [resources](resources.html) pages are
plain Markdown and are edited directly in `publications.qmd` and
`resources.qmd`.
